name: Search in text fields
description: Autotagger plugin that scans a node's configured text/reference/paragraph fields for taxonomy term labels and appends the matching terms.
project_description: Submodule of Autotagger. Provides the 'Search in Text fields' Autotagger plugin (plugin id search_in_text_fields), the only tagging implementation shipped with the project. It adds an 'Autotagger' settings group to the node type add/edit form where you pick source fields to scan and a destination taxonomy_term entity_reference field. On node presave it concatenates the text of the configured source fields (including text fields on referenced entities and nested paragraphs), lowercases and normalizes it, and appends any vocabulary term whose label appears as a whole-word substring. Matching is purely local literal text matching — no AI, no external services.
